Evolve the `PaymentGateway::charge` function to accept a transaction descriptor string parameter.
Specifically, change the signature of `PaymentGateway::charge` (and the corresponding delegator `PaymentService::authorize`) to:

    bool charge(const std::string& user_id, double amount, const std::string& descriptor);
    bool authorize(const std::string& user_id, double amount, const std::string& descriptor);

Ensure that all definitions are updated. Update the call sites of `authorize` within the checkout/order system to pass appropriate descriptors:
- Inside `OrderService::submit`, pass `"user_checkout"`.
- Inside `AdminOrderService::submit`, pass `"admin_bulk"`.

Be careful: the class `BillingGateway` also exposes a `charge` method. This class is unrelated to the payment gateway and its signature must remain completely unchanged. Other gateway/service methods like `refund` must also remain unchanged.
